eligibility: Enrolled on an eligible postgraduate programme for the September 2027 or January 2028 intake

National of one of the eligible countries: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, India, Indonesia, Israel, Jordan, Kenya, Lebanon, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, Palestine, Singapore, Syria, Thailand, Vietnam or Yemen
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be enrolled on an eligible University of Glasgow postgraduate programme for the September 2027 or January 2028 intake, hold nationality of one of 19 listed countries, and have international fee status.
requirements: Meet the entry criteria for one of the listed eligible postgraduate programmes
Hold international fee status and an eligible nationality
application_method: No separate application; the tuition fee discount is applied at registration and confirmed by email after the programme offer
existing.selection_notes: Awarded automatically to all applicants who meet the entry criteria; the University publishes no separate selection process or academic threshold.
existing.notes: This is the postgraduate World Changers award; the University also runs a separate undergraduate World Changers Global Excellence Scholarship, which is a distinct scheme.
